(< κονία, dust, ⟪lime⟫), [in LXX: ⟦Deuteronomy 27:2|De 27:2⟧, ⟦Deuteronomy 27:4|4⟧ (⁨שִׂיד⁩), ⟦Proverbs 21:9|Pr 21:9⟧*;] ⟪to plaster⟫ or ⟪whiten over⟫: of tombs, ⟦Matthew 23:27|Mt 23:27⟧; fig., of a hypocrite, ⟦Acts 23:3|Ac 23:3⟧.†

G2868.b:
⟪κονιορτός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up), [in LXX for ⁨אָבָק⁩, etc.;] in cl., ⟪dust stirred up⟫ (⟦Exodus 9:9|Ex 9:9⟧, ⟦Isaiah 5:24|Is 5:24⟧); in NT, simply ⟪dust⟫: ⟦Matthew 10:14|Mt 10:14⟧, ⟦Luke 9:5|Lk 9:5⟧ ⟦Luke 10:11|10:11⟧, ⟦Acts 13:51|Ac 13:51⟧ ⟦Acts 22:23|22:23⟧.†

G2869.b:
⟪κοπάζω⟫
(< κόπος), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 8:1|Ge 8:1⟧, ⟦Ezra 2:1|Es 2:1⟧ ⟦Ezra 7:10|7:10⟧ (⁨שׁכךְ⁩), ⟦Ruth 1:18|Ru 1:18⟧, al. (⁨חדל⁩), ⟦Jonah 1:11|Jh 1:11⟧, ⟦Jonah 1:12|12⟧ (⁨שׁתק⁩), al.;] ⟪to grow weary⟫; of the wind (Hdt., ⟦Jonah 1:11|Jh 1:11⟧, ⟦Jonah 1:12|12⟧), ⟪to abate⟫, ⟪cease raging⟫: ⟦Matthew 14:32|Mt 14:32⟧, ⟦Mark 4:39|Mk 4:39⟧ ⟦Mark 6:51|6:51⟧.†

G2870.b:
⟪κοπετός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨מִסְפֵּד⁩;] = cl. κομμός, ⟪a beating of the head and breast⟫, ⟪lamentation⟫: seq. ἐπί c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 8:2|Ac 8:2⟧.†

G2871.b:
⟪κοπή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ
(< κόπτω), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 14:17|Ge 14:17⟧, ⟦Joshua 10:20|Jos 10:20⟧ (⁨נכה⁩ hi., ⁨מַכָּה⁩), ⟦Deuteronomy 28:25|De 28:25⟧ (⁨נגף⁩), Jth 15:7*;]
⟪1.⟫ in cl., ⟪a stroke⟫, ⟪a pounding⟫ (as in a mortar).
⟪2.⟫ In LXX, ⟪a smiting⟫ in battle: ⟦Hebrews 7:1|He 7:1⟧(LXX).†

G2872.b:
⟪κοπιάω⟫, -ῶ
(< κόπος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨יגע⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ (as in cl.) ⟪to grow weary⟫: ⟦Matthew 11:28|Mt 11:28⟧, ⟦John 4:6|Jo 4:6⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:3|Re 2:3⟧ (cf. ⟦Isaiah 40:31|Is 40:31⟧).
⟪2.⟫ Hence, in LXX and NT, ⟪to work with effort⟫, ⟪to toil⟫: absol., ⟦Matthew 6:28|Mt 6:28⟧, ⟦Luke 5:5|Lk 5:5⟧ ⟦Luke 12:27|12:27⟧, ⟦John 4:38|Jo 4:38⟧, ⟦Acts 20:35|Ac 20:35⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:12|I Co 4:12⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:28|Eph 4:28⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:6|II Ti 2:6⟧; c. acc. rei, ⟦John 4:38|Jo 4:38⟧; freq. in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: ⟦1 Corinthians 15:10|I Co 15:10⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 16:16|16:16⟧; seq. ἐν, ⟦Romans 16:12|Ro 16:12⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:12|I Th 5:12⟧ (v. M, Th., in l.), ⟦1 Timothy 5:17|I Ti 5:17⟧; εἰς, ⟦Romans 16:6|Ro 16:6⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:11|Ga 4:11⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:16|Phl 2:16⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:29|Col 1:29⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 4:10|I Ti 4:10⟧.†
a: St. Paul's Epistles to the Thessalonians, by G. Milligan. Macmillan, 1908

G2873.b:
⟪κόπος⟫, -ου, ὁ
(< κόπτω), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨עָמָל⁩, also for ⁨אָוֶן⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a striking⟫, ⟪beating⟫ (in ⟦Jeremiah 45:3|Je 51:33 (45:3)⟧ = κοπετός).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪laborious toil⟫, ⟪trouble⟫: ⟦John 4:38|Jo 4:38⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:8|I Co 3:8⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 15:58|15:58⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 3:5|I Th 3:5⟧; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, ⟦1 Thessalonians 1:3|I Th 1:3⟧; ἔργα καὶ κ., ⟦Revelation 2:2|Re 2:2⟧; κ. καὶ μόχθος, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:27|II Co 11:27⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 2:9|I Th 2:9⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 3:8|II Th 3:8⟧; pl., ἐν κ., ⟦2 Corinthians 6:5|II Co 6:5⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 10:15|10:15⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 11:23|11:23⟧; ἐκ τ. κ., ⟦Revelation 14:13|Re 14:13⟧; κόπους (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more freq. π. πράγματα, πονον), c. dat. pers., ⟦Matthew 26:10|Mt 26:10⟧, ⟦Mark 14:6|Mk 14:6⟧, ⟦Luke 11:7|Lk 11:7⟧ ⟦Luke 18:5|18:5⟧, ⟦Galatians 6:17|Ga 6:17⟧.†
SYN.: μόλθος, labour; πόνος (q.v.), toil, painful effort; in cl., "π. gives prominence to the effort (work as requiring force), κ. to the fatigue, μ. (chiefly poetic) to the hardship" (Thayer, s.v. κ.).

G2874.b:
⟪κοπρία⟫, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨אַשְׁפֹּת⁩;] ⟪a dung hill⟫ (⟦1 Samuel 2:8|I Ki 2:8⟧, ⟦Psalms 113:7|Ps 112 (113):7⟧ al.): ⟦Luke 14:35|Lk 14:35⟧.†

G2875.b:
⟪κόπτω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨כּרת⁩, ⁨ספד⁩, ⁨נכה⁩ hi., etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to strike⟫, ⟪smite⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to cut off⟫: c. acc. rei, seq. ἀπό, ⟦Matthew 21:8|Mt 21:8⟧; ἐκ, ⟦Mark 11:8|Mk 11:8⟧. Mid., ⟪to beat one's breast⟫ with grief, ⟪to mourn⟫, ⟪bewail⟫: ⟦Matthew 11:17|Mt 11:17⟧ ⟦Matthew 24:30|24:30⟧; c. acc. pers., ⟦Luke 8:52|Lk 8:52⟧ ⟦Luke 23:27|23:27⟧; seq. ἐπί, c. acc., ⟦Revelation 1:7|Re 1:7⟧ ⟦Revelation 18:9|18:9⟧ (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).†
SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v.

G2877.b:
⟪κοράσιον⟫, -ου, τό,
(dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨נַעֲרָה⁩, ⟦Ruth 2:8|Ru 2:8⟧, al.; in ⟦Joel 3:3|Jl 3 (4):3⟧, ⟦Zechariah 8:5|Za 8:5⟧ for ⁨יַלְדָּה⁩;] a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, 154), ⟪girl⟫, ⟪maiden⟫: ⟦Matthew 9:24|Mt 9:24⟧, ⟦Matthew 9:25|25⟧ ⟦Matthew 14:11|14:11⟧, ⟦Mark 5:41|Mk 5:41⟧, ⟦Mark 5:42|42⟧ ⟦Mark 6:22|6:22⟧, ⟦Mark 6:28|28⟧.†

G2878.b: *† ⟪κορβάν⟫ (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. ⁨קׇרְבָּן⁩), ⟪an offering⟫, ⟪a gift⟫ offered to God: ⟦Mark 7:11|Mk 7:11⟧ (cf. κορβανᾶς).†

G2880.b:
** ⟪κορέννυμι⟫
(< κόρος, surfeit), [in Sm.: ⟦Psalms 22:27|Ps 21 (22):27⟧, Al, ⟦Psalms 103:5|102 (103):5⟧*;] ⟪to satisfy⟫: pass., τροφῆς, ⟦Acts 27:38|Ac 27:38⟧; metaph., of spiritual things, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:8|I Co 4:8⟧.†

G2881.b: ⟪κορίνθιος⟫, -α, -ον, ⟪Corinthian⟫; as subst., ὁ Κ., ⟪a Corinthian⟫: ⟦Acts 18:8|Ac 18:8⟧, ⟦Acts 18:27|27⟧ (WH, txt., R, omit), ⟦2 Corinthians 6:11|II Co 6:11⟧; 1Co, 2Co, tit.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G2882.b: ⟪Κόρινθος⟫, -ου, ἡ, ⟪Corinth⟫: ⟦Acts 18:1|Ac 18:1⟧, ⟦Acts 18:27|27⟧ ⟦Acts 19:1|19:1⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:2|I Co 1:2⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 1:1|II Co 1:1⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 1:23|23⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 4:20|II Ti 4:20⟧.†

G2884.b:
⟪κόρος⟫, -ου, ὁ
(Heb. ⁨כֹּר⁩), [in LXX: ⟦Leviticus 27:16|Le 27:16⟧, ⟦Numbers 11:32|Nu 11:32⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 45:13|Ez 45:13⟧ (⁨חֹמֶר⁩); more freq., ⟦2 Chronicles 27:5|II Ch 27:5⟧, al.(⁨כֹּר⁩);] ⟪a cor⟫, a Hebrew measure (AV, RV, measure): ⟦Luke 16:7|Lk 16:7⟧.†

G2885.b:
⟪κοσμέω⟫, -ῶ
(< κόσμος), [in LXX for ⁨עדה⁩, ⁨תּקן⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to order⟫, ⟪arrange⟫, ⟪prepare⟫ (in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): ⟦Matthew 25:7|Mt 25:7⟧ (cf. Si 50:9, al.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to adorn⟫, ⟪furnish⟫: οἶκον, pass., ⟦Matthew 12:44|Mt 12:44⟧, ⟦Luke 11:25|Lk 11:25⟧; μνημεῖα, ⟦Matthew 23:29|Mt 23:29⟧; τὸ ἱερόν, pass., ⟦Luke 21:5|Lk 21:5⟧; θεμέλιοι, ⟦Revelation 21:19|Re 21:19⟧; νύμφην, pass., ⟦Revelation 21:2|Re 21:2⟧; ἑαυτάς, seq. ἐν, ⟦1 Timothy 2:9|I Ti 2:9⟧. Metaph., c. acc. pers., ⟦1 Peter 3:5|I Pe 3:5⟧; c. acc. rei, ⟦Titus 2:10|Tit 2:10⟧.†

G2886.b:
* ⟪κοσμικός⟫, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος),
⟪1.⟫ ⟪pertaining to the world⟫ or ⟪universe⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪of this world⟫, ⟪earthly⟫. ⟦Hebrews 9:1|He 9:1⟧.
⟪3.⟫ In ethical sense, ⟪worldly⟫: ἐπιθυμίαι, ⟦Titus 2:12|Tit 2:12⟧.†

G2887.b:
⟪κόσμιος⟫, -ον (in cl. -α, -ον),
(< κόσμος), [in LXX: ⟦Ecclesiastes 12:9|Ec 12:9⟧ (⁨תּקן⁩)*;] ⟪orderly⟫, ⟪decent⟫, ⟪modest⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 2:9|I Ti 2:9⟧ (WH, mg., -ίως, q.v.) ⟦1 Timothy 3:2|3:2⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G2888.b:
*† ⟪κοσμοκράτωρ⟫, -ορος, ὁ
(< κόσμος, κρατέω),
⟪1.⟫ in Orphic hymns, al. (v. AR, ⟦Ephesians 6:12|Eph 6:12⟧), ⟪a ruler of the whole world⟫ (and so in Rabbinic writings: ⁨קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר⁩).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a ruler of this world⟫ (in contrast to παντοκράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, ⟪the rulers of this dark world⟫, ⟦Ephesians 6:12|Eph 6:12⟧.†
a: St. Paul's Epistle to the Ephesians, by J. Armitage Robinson. Second Edition. Macmillan, 1909

G2889.b:
⟪κόσμος⟫, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 2:1|Ge 2:1⟧, ⟦Deuteronomy 4:19|De 4:19⟧ ⟦Deuteronomy 17:3|17:3⟧, ⟦Isaiah 24:21|Is 24:21⟧ ⟦Isaiah 40:26|40:26⟧ (⁨צבא⁩), ⟦Exodus 33:5|Ex 33:5⟧, ⟦Exodus 33:6|6⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 2:32|Je 2:32⟧ ⟦Jeremiah 4:30|4:30⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 7:20|Ez 7:20⟧ ⟦Ezekiel 16:11|16:11⟧ ⟦Ezekiel 23:40|23:40⟧ (⁨עֲדִי⁩), ⟦Isaiah 61:10|Is 61:10⟧ (⁨כְּלִי⁩), al., Wi 2:24 and freq., Si 6:30, al;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪order⟫ (Hom., Plat., al.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪ornament⟫, ⟪adornment⟫, esp. of women (Hom., al.): ⟦1 Peter 3:3|I Pe 3:3⟧.
⟪3.⟫ Later, the ⟪world⟫ or ⟪universe⟫, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): ⟦Acts 17:24|Ac 17:24⟧, ⟦Romans 4:13|Ro 4:13⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:22|I Co 3:22⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:15|Phl 2:15⟧, ⟦Hebrews 4:3|He 4:3⟧, al.
⟪4.⟫ In late writers only, ⟪the world⟫, i.e. ⟪the earth⟫ (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. ⟦Matthew 4:8|Mt 4:8⟧ with ⟦Luke 4:5|Lk 4:5⟧): ⟦Matthew 4:8|Mt 4:8⟧, ⟦Mark 16:15|Mk 16:[15]⟧, ⟦Colossians 2:20|Col 2:20⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 6:7|I Ti 6:7⟧, al.; hence by meton.,
	⟪(a)⟫ of the human inhabitants of the world: ⟦Matthew 5:14|Mt 5:14⟧ ⟦Matthew 13:38|13:38⟧, ⟦Mark 14:9|Mk 14:9⟧, ⟦John 1:10|Jo 1:10⟧ ⟦John 4:42|4:42⟧ ⟦John 12:47|12:47⟧, ⟦Romans 3:6|Ro 3:6⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:13|I Co 4:13⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 5:19|II Co 5:19⟧, ⟦2 Peter 2:5|II Pe 2:5⟧, al.;
	⟪(b)⟫ of worldly affairs or possessions: ⟦Matthew 16:26|Mt 16:26⟧, ⟦Mark 8:36|Mk 8:36⟧, ⟦Luke 9:25|Lk 9:25⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:31|I Co 7:31⟧, ⟦1 John 2:16|I Jo 2:16⟧, al.;
	⟪(c)⟫ in ethical sense, of the ungodly: ⟦John 7:7|Jo 7:7⟧ ⟦John 14:17|14:17⟧, ⟦John 14:27|27⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:21|I Co 1:21⟧, ⟦James 1:27|Ja 1:27⟧, ⟦1 John 4:4|I Jo 4:4⟧, al.;
	⟪(d)⟫ metaph.: ὁ κ. τῆς ἀδικίας, ⟦James 3:6|Ja 3:6⟧.
SYN.: αἰών, q.v. (cf . also Dalman, Words, 162 ff.; Tr., Syn., § lix; Westc., additional note on ⟦John 1:10|Jo 1:10⟧; DB, iv, 938 ff.).
a: The Words of Jesus, by G. Dalman. English Edition. T. & T. Clark, 1902

Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880

G2891.b: ⟪κούμ⟫ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, ⁨קוּם⁩), ⟪koum⟫ (⟪arise⟫): ⟦Mark 5:41|Mk 5:41⟧.†

G2893.b:
⟪κουφίζω⟫
(< κοῦφος, light), [in LXX: ⟦Exodus 18:22|Ex 18:22⟧, ⟦Jonah 1:5|Jh 1:5⟧, al. (⁨קלל⁩ hi.), ⟦Ezra 5:1|Es 5:1⟧, al.;]
⟪1.⟫ intrans., ⟪to be light⟫ (poetic chiefly).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to lighten⟫, ⟪make light⟫: c. acc., ⟦Acts 27:38|Ac 27:38⟧.†

G2894.b:
⟪κόφινος⟫, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: ⟦Judges 6:19|Jg 6:19⟧ (⁨סַל⁩), ⟦Psalms 81:6|Ps 80 (81):6⟧ (⁨דּוּד⁩)*;] ⟪a basket⟫, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food: ⟦Matthew 14:20|Mt 14:20⟧ ⟦Matthew 16:9|16:9⟧, ⟦Mark 6:43|Mk 6:43⟧ ⟦Mark 8:19|8:19⟧ ⟦Luke 9:17|Lk 9:17⟧ ⟦Luke 13:8|13:8⟧, ⟦John 6:13|Jo 6:13⟧ (cf. σφυρίς).†

G2895.b:
**† ⟪κράβαττος⟫ (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ
(a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), [in Aq.: ⟦Amos 3:12|Am 3:12⟧*;] ⟪a camp bed⟫, ⟪pallet⟫: ⟦Mark 2:4|Mk 2:4⟧, ⟦Mark 2:9|9⟧, ⟦Mark 2:11|11⟧, ⟦Mark 2:12|12⟧ ⟦Mark 6:55|6:55⟧, ⟦John 5:8|Jo 5:8-11⟧, ⟦Acts 5:15|Ac 5:15⟧ ⟦Acts 9:33|9:33⟧ (v. Swete, ⟦Mark 2:4|Mk., 2:4⟧, and cf. κλίνη).†
a: Commentaries on the Gospel according to St. Mark (Third Edition, 1909) and the Apocalypse of St. John, by H. B. Swete. Macmillan, 1906

G2896.b:
⟪κράζω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨זעק⁩, ⁨צעק⁩, ⁨קרא⁩, etc.;] in cl. chiefly poët.,
⟪1.⟫ prop. onomatop., of the raven, ⟪to croak⟫, hence generally, of inartic. cries, ⟪to scream⟫, ⟪cry out⟫ (Æsch., al.): ⟦Mark 5:5|Mk 5:5⟧ ⟦Mark 9:26|9:26⟧ ⟦Mark 15:39|15:39⟧ (Rec., R, mg.), ⟦Luke 9:39|Lk 9:39⟧, al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. ⟦Genesis 4:10|Ge 4:10⟧), ⟦James 5:4|Ja 5:4⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to cry⟫, ⟪call⟫ ⟪out⟫ with a loud voice: c. acc. rei, ⟦Acts 19:32|Ac 19:32⟧; seq. orat. dir., ⟦Mark 10:48|Mk 10:48⟧, ⟦Luke 18:39|Lk 18:39⟧, al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, ⟦Mark 5:7|Mk 5:7⟧, ⟦Revelation 14:15|Re 14:15⟧, al.; λέγων, ⟦Matthew 8:29|Mt 8:29⟧, al.; of public teaching, ⟦John 1:15|Jo 1:15⟧, ⟦Romans 9:27|Ro 9:27⟧, al.; of importunate prayer (cf. ⟦Job 35:12|Jb 35:12⟧, ⟦Psalms 3:5|Ps 3:5⟧, al.), ⟦Romans 8:15|Ro 8:15⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:6|Ga 4:6⟧; pf. with pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), ⟦John 1:15|Jo 1:15⟧.
SYN.: v.s. βοάω.
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G2897.b:
* ⟪κραιπάλη⟫
(κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for ⁨שׁכר⁩, ⟦Isaiah 24:20|Is 24:20⟧ ⟦Isaiah 29:9|29:9⟧), ⟪drunken nausea⟫ (EV, surfeiting): ⟦Luke 21:34|Lk 21:34⟧.†
SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (v. Tr., Syn., § lxi).
a: Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880
The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G2898.b:
⟪κρανίον⟫, -ου, τό
(< κάρα, the head), [in LXX: ⟦Judges 9:53|Jg 9:53⟧, ⟦2 Kings 9:35|IV Ki 9:35⟧ (⁨גֻּלְגֹּלֶת⁩)*;] ⟪a skull⟫: ⟦Matthew 27:33|Mt 27:33⟧, ⟦Mark 15:22|Mk 15:22⟧, ⟦Luke 23:33|Lk 23:33⟧, ⟦John 19:17|Jo 19:17⟧.†

G2899.b:
⟪κράσπεδον⟫, -ου, τό,
